method: Exact equality of recovered function start RVAs and half-open [start_rva,end_rva) pairs against source-labelled ranges; unbounded candidates count for starts but not ranges. Results are grouped separately by matching-PDB and stripped inputs.
threshold_policy: These are the v1 checked-in floor thresholds, not claims about arbitrary PE files. Raise a floor only after reviewing an expanded corpus and reproducing its command, toolchain, source/input hashes, and ground truth.
